introduction.en: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a multilateral development bank established in 2016 to support infrastructure development in the Asia-Pacific region.
introduction.hi: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank (AIIB) is a multilateral development bank established in 2016 to support infrastructure development in the Asia-Pacific region.

body.en: Asia faces a massive infrastructure deficit, estimated in the trillions. AIIB complements existing institutions like the ADB and World Bank by providing long-term capital. For India, AIIB is crucial as it provides funding for projects like the Bangalore Metro and renewable energy initiatives. It also allows India to play a key role in setting regional standards and enhancing connectivity.

conclusion.en: AIIB serves as a vital instrument for India to achieve its infrastructure goals while strengthening its geopolitical footprint in the region.
